name: Adventure Science Center
tagline: Nashville classic — Adventure Tower energy, body science, space, and a makerspace.

practical.ticket_note: Check adventuresci.org for tickets and planetarium times.
practical.best_start: Adventure Tower or Early Explorations first if legs are fresh.

do_not_list.name: Imaginarium
do_not_list.reason: Not an Adventure Science Center exhibit — children's-museum taxonomy leakage.

do_not_list.name: Creative Makery
do_not_list.reason: ASC has Makerspace, not Creative Makery.

do_not_list.name: Toddler Garden
do_not_list.reason: Use Early Explorations for little kids, not Toddler Garden.

items.label: Adventure Tower
items.one_liner: Climb, crawl, and burn energy in the big tower.

qa_card.question: What was the wildest part of the tower?
qa_card.answer: Tell a grown-up one thing you climbed or crawled through!

items.label: BodyQuest
items.one_liner: Journey through the human body — heart, lungs, and more.

qa_card.question: What body part did you explore?
qa_card.answer: Heart, lungs, bones — pick one detail!

items.label: Fossil Frontiers
items.one_liner: Fossils from Middle Tennessee — dig into deep time.

qa_card.question: What fossil shape stuck with you?

items.label: Makerspace
items.one_liner: Dream it up and build something with your hands.

qa_card.question: What did you make or try to invent?
qa_card.answer: Tell a grown-up one idea you tested!

items.label: Early Explorations
items.one_liner: Little-kid zone for ages about five and under.

qa_card.question: What was your favorite little-kid stop?
qa_card.answer: Climb, splash, or quiet play — pick one!

items.label: Solar System Survey
items.one_liner: Compare Earth to other planets — light and gravity.

qa_card.question: Which planet would you visit and why?
qa_card.answer: Pick one and give one reason!

items.label: Wonders of the Universe
items.one_liner: Astronomy up close — look for the Curiosity rover model.

qa_card.question: What space tool or rover detail did you notice?

items.label: Physics of Flight
items.one_liner: Test wing shapes and how air lifts planes.

qa_card.question: Which wing shape worked best?
qa_card.answer: Wide, skinny, or something silly — what flew?

items.label: Galactic Gardens
items.one_liner: Outdoor learning when weather is friendly.

qa_card.question: What living thing did you spot outside?
qa_card.answer: Plant, bug, or bird — describe it!

items.label: Sudekum Planetarium
items.one_liner: Sit back for a sky show (check showtimes).

qa_card.question: What was one cool thing in the sky show?
qa_card.answer: A planet, star, or story moment!

research_notes: Presence audit 2026-08-08 vs adventuresci.org exhibits list. Replaced Perot/CM taxonomy leakage with real ASC names.
